table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	CustomerAliasName = A.AliasName,
	SaleType = (SELECT ST.Name FROM SaleType ST WHERE ST.SaleTypeCode = :ai_SaleTypeCode),
	PatientCode=P.PatientCode,
	Regno=P.RegNo,
	EmployeeName = P.Name,
	Designation = (SELECT R.Name FROM Rank R WHERE P.RankCode = R.RankCode),
	CustCode=S.CustCode,
	DAte=S.Date,
	SaleTypeCode=S.SaleTypeCode,
	SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = D.LooseQty,
	Amount = (D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) * (1 + :ad_servicecharge * 0.01)
FROM
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Patient P,
	SaleLedger S,
	SaleDetail D,
	Item I
WHERE		
	S.PatientCode = CASE WHEN :ai_allpatients = 0 THEN :ai_patientcode ELSE P.PatientCode END AND
	S.SaleTypeCode = :ai_SaleTypeCode AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	S.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	CustomerAliasName = A.AliasName,
	SaleType = NULL,
	PatientCode=P.PatientCode,
	Regno=P.RegNo,
	EmployeeName = P.Name,
	Designation = (SELECT R.Name FROM Rank R WHERE P.RankCode = R.RankCode),
	CustCode=C.CustCode,
	DAte=Date,
	SaleTypeCode=NULL,
	SaleInvCode=NULL,
	AliasName = NULL,
	ItemName = NULL,
	Qty = NULL,
	Amount = NULL
FROM
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	Patient P
WHERE		
	P.PatientCode = CASE WHEN :ai_allpatients = 0 THEN :ai_patientcode ELSE P.PatientCode END AND
	P.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	P.PatientCode NOT IN 
		(SELECT DISTINCT S.PatientCode 
		FROM SaleLedger S
		WHERE	
			S.PatientCode = CASE WHEN :ai_allpatients = 0 THEN :ai_patientcode ELSE P.PatientCode END AND
			S.SaleTypeCode = :ai_SaleTypeCode AND
			S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate)
table.sort: customername A, saletype A, employeename A, itemname A, qty A
